adr: ADR-160 D6 item 1 — every part that is not printed is a row with a mass, an approximate price and a source line. These are the explorer's bought and fabricated rows in the shape the one-parts-model rows use (embodied/src-routes/engine/design/parts-catalog.json: identity, massG and approxUsd of one unit, a source line), so adopting shared rows later is a re-point, not a rewrite.
what: The report's bill of materials (docs/research/ambient-energy-vessel-report.pdf, section 4) for its sweep winner, re-scoped to the explorer: one wing hinge per wing instead of eight, everything else as listed. Quantities, specifications and make/buy are the report's.
notPublished: No row carries a mass or a price. The report says 'Costs are deliberately omitted -- no sourcing was done, and any figure here would be invented', publishes no masses, and the study deleted an earlier bill of materials because its per-line costs were fabricated. A null here is that fact kept, never a zero: the parts model cannot be parts-complete and the displacement budget cannot close until real rows (a chosen part, its weighed or listed mass, its price and where both came from) replace them.

units.approxUsd: approximate US street price of one unit, US dollars
